subject: Request: Onramp accelerator — combined credit + rate concession for CumulusBio
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simmons <lsimmons@cumulusbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Onramp accelerator — initial terms and next steps

Hi Laura — great to meet last week. Following up with the tailored onramp summary we discussed. CumulusBio's product team ran a short eval with our hosted API and liked the latency and reliability at medium token sizes. To help you hit your internal demo & regulator milestones, the customer team asked if we can support a higher starter credit and a short-term rate concession to make the first month usage predictable.

High-level ask from CumulusBio: 75k free credits to cover the pilot and a 20% unit-rate discount for the first 90 days while they validate throughput. They indicated procurement will move quickly with a PO if we can give a single-line commercial buffer and a short statement of work.

Proposed compromise (what I plan to ask for approval): 60,000 starter credits + 15% discount for 90 days, conditional on a signed PO committing to a 6-month minimum thereafter (standard onramp commit). This keeps upside for Redwood and gets them across procurement.

Attached: cumulusbio-proposal-v2.pdf (proposal + SOW sketch). Can you look quick and advise if we should escalate to exec for an exception? Need signoff by EOD Tuesday to keep their procurement timeline.

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | (415) 555-0128
From: Laura Simmons <lsimmons@cumulusbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: CumulusBio Procurement <procurement@cumulusbio.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp accelerator — initial terms and next steps

Vivek — thanks for the note and the quick turnaround on the proposal. The team is excited; two clarifications from procurement and our CTO:

1) Credits: to cover the pilot scope we actually need about 75k tokens (not 60k). We can share the prompt set if useful.
2) Commercials: Procurement prefers a 20% introductory discount for 90 days, then revert to standard list. They said a 6-month commitment is fine if the pricing cliff after the intro discount is smoothed (they don't want a surprise jump).

Procurement timeline: if we get an approved commercial summary by Friday and a short SOW, procurement can issue the PO next week. Otherwise we risk slipping to their next procurement cycle in early May.

Can we escalate for an exception? Happy to hop on a quick call with Marissa if that helps.

—Laura
Laura Simmons
Head of Platform Engineering, CumulusBio
lsimmons@cumulusbio.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CumulusBio request — need exec exception for combined credit + discount

Internal — forwarding the ask from CumulusBio. They pushed from 60k/15% to 75k/20% for the 90-day intro. Procurement will issue a PO if we can provide an approved commercial commit summary by Friday.

My recommended concession (balanced): approve up to 60k starter credits + 12% discount for 90 days, with an optional 6-month smoothing clause: after the intro period, revert to list price over a 60-day ramp (i.e., 12% -> 6% -> 0%). We keep predictable revenue while giving CumulusBio runway. If Marissa/Finance prefer to stay closer to their ask, I'd ask for a capped credit top-up (one-time add-on) if they hit agreed evaluation milestones.

Key risk: this is the first Healthcare vertical-ish biotech reference in the west region; wins here help our platform positioning. Procurement is timeboxed.

Attached: underwriting-summary.xlsx (usage profile + proposed limits).

Would appreciate quick guidance — can we get a yes/no so I can respond?

Thanks, Vivek
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CumulusBio request — need exec exception for combined credit + discount

Vivek — quick thoughts from a pricing/finance lens:

- 75k free credits at our marginal cost looks high for a first pilot without a signed commit. 60k is in the range we've historically approved as a one-time top-up for smaller onramps.
- 20% intro discount is steep but acceptable as a limited, time-boxed concession if we get a short-term revenue guarantee or PO. The smoothing clause Vivek proposes is good — reduces churn risk.

If Marissa is comfortable with a one-time exception, I recommend structuring it as: 60k credits + 12% discount for 90 days, contingent on a PO for a minimum 6-month term at a moderated post-discount schedule. Legal should add a clause that unused credits expire at the end of the intro period.

I'll flag Finance and Legal to be ready; legal will need final SOW language. If Marissa okays, we should have CS (Grace) do an onboarding readiness check immediately.

-Aditya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T12:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CumulusBio request — need exec exception for combined credit + discount

Vivek / Aditya — I reviewed the ask and approve a one-time exception with conditions. Approvals below:

Approved concession: 60,000 complimentary credits + 12% unit-rate discount for the first 90 days.
Conditions / required steps before signature:
- Procurement must submit a PO that references the attached SOW and commits to a 6-month minimum term.
- Unused free credits expire at the end of the 90-day intro period (explicitly stated in contract).
- Post-intro pricing will ramp down over 60 days per Aditya's smoothing proposal to avoid a cliff.
- CS (Grace) to deliver onboarding milestones and a short validation checklist; payment milestone tied to first milestone.
- Legal to add the one-time exception clause and record this in the CRM as an "onramp sweetener — exec exception" (so future renewals don't automatically assume this).

Finance — treat expected revenue as committed post-PO and amortize credits for internal reporting. This is a strategic reference; I want the team to move quickly but protect margin.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Approved at 2028-03-22T12:12:00-07:00
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simmons <lsimmons@cumulusbio.com>, CumulusBio Procurement <procurement@cumulusbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-28T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp accelerator — approved summary and next steps

Laura — good news: we can approve a one-time exception. Summary of approved terms below (per Marissa's signoff):

- 60,000 complimentary credits applied to your Redwood Onramp account (one-time).
- 12% unit-rate discount for the first 90 days.
- Unused complimentary credits expire at the end of the 90-day intro period.
- After the intro period, pricing will ramp down over 60 days (12% -> 6% -> 0%).
- Condition: Procurement issues a PO referencing the attached SOW and commits to a 6-month minimum term.

Next steps:
1) I've attached the updated proposal (cumulusbio-proposal-v2.pdf) and the underwriting summary.
2) Grace (CC) will schedule the onboarding kickoff and send a short checklist.
3) Legal will issue a short addendum reflecting the exception language; we'll share a DocuSign link for signature: https://www.docusign.com/CB-2028-Onramp-Proposal-Envelope

Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through the SOW this week; procurement, if you can get the PO over by next Wednesday we'll target a first-week-of-April start.

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

Attachments: cumulusbio-proposal-v2.pdf (proposal + SOW), underwriting-summary.xlsx (usage profile)
